questions.q: If $\tan \theta = \frac{12}{5}$, what is the value of $\sec \theta$?
questions.explain: Using the trigonometric identity $\sec^2 \theta = 1 + \tan^2 \theta$, we get $\sec^2 \theta = 1 + (\frac{12}{5})^2 = 1 + \frac{144}{25} = \frac{169}{25}$. Therefore, $\sec \theta = \frac{13}{5}$.
